question: Which Indian city topped the Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2024 in the category of cities with a population over 10 lakh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indore topped the **Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2024** in the category of cities with a population of over 10 lakh.
 
• The ranking is part of the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)**, which monitors and evaluates air quality levels in cities across India.
 
• Indore has consistently performed well in various cleanliness and sustainability indices due to its innovative waste management practices and environmental policies.
 
• Key factors contributing to Indore's top ranking include **effective public participation, air pollution control measures, and solid waste management initiatives**.
 
• The city has been a regular recipient of accolades for its efforts in cleanliness, including being ranked as India’s cleanest city under the Swachh Survekshan initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bengaluru**

 
 
• Bengaluru, also known as the "Silicon Valley of India," is one of the country’s major metropolitan cities, but it faces significant air quality challenges due to traffic congestion and industrial emissions.
 
• Despite its technological advancements, Bengaluru has struggled with particulate matter (PM) levels, making consistent improvements in air quality a challenge.
 
• The city has initiated steps to improve its air quality, such as promoting electric vehicles and enhancing public transportation infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**
 
 
• Mumbai, India’s financial capital, faces severe air pollution issues, primarily due to vehicle emissions, industrial activities, and construction dust.
 
• The coastal city has taken measures to combat air pollution, including the introduction of cleaner fuels and stricter emission norms.
 
• Efforts like the Mumbai Climate Action Plan aim to reduce emissions and improve air quality over the long term.
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad**
 
 
• Ahmedabad has been proactive in tackling air pollution through its **Ahmedabad Air Information and Response (AIR) Plan**, which focuses on reducing particulate matter levels.
 
• The city has implemented measures such as expanding green cover, promoting the use of public transport, and regulating industrial emissions.
 
• Ahmedabad is also a participant in the NCAP and has shown progress in improving air quality metrics over the years.
 
 
 
• **Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan**
 
 
• The Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan is an initiative under the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) to rank cities based on their efforts to improve air quality.
 
• The program evaluates cities based on parameters such as reduction in PM2.5 and PM10 levels, implementation of clean air action plans, and public awareness campaigns.
 
• It aims to encourage cities to adopt sustainable practices and innovative solutions to reduce air pollution.
